status: frozen after V19BK observability admission but before terminal V19X3 measurements, observed V19X4 gas-state products, any source-invariant score, any lensing or halo target, or any action or gravity selection
purpose: Freeze the coordinate-safe projected I4 and I5 algebra and the complete source-only decision gates that will be applied unchanged to both merger clusters.

registered_inputs.stellar_draw_pairing: Use member-ensemble sample_id 0 through 4095, paired by equal sample_id to the 4096 V19X4 gas draws. This pairing represents independent Monte Carlo nuisance draws and no physical gas-star covariance.
registered_inputs.stellar_normalization: Within every cluster and draw, divide finite nonnegative member luminosities by their total before cloud-in-cell deposition and mask-normalized Gaussian smoothing. Never compare Bullet Bessel-I and Abell 2146 F814W amplitudes.
registered_inputs.derivative_rule: Second-order centered differences on the common east/north physical grid; a derivative pixel is invalid unless every required stencil pixel is finite.

I4_THERMODYNAMIC_GRADIENT_STRESS.dimensionless_equation: a_i=D_i ln(n_e); k_i=D_i ln(K); Q_ij=l^2[a_(i k_j)-delta_ij(a dot k)/2]
I4_THERMODYNAMIC_GRADIENT_STRESS.stored_components: q_plus=Q_EE=l^2(a_E k_E-a_N k_N)/2; q_cross=Q_EN=l^2(a_E k_N+a_N k_E)/2
I4_THERMODYNAMIC_GRADIENT_STRESS.coordinate_rule: The tensor components transform as spin two; amplitude, axial differences and the joint PRESS novelty score are rotation invariant.

I5_BAROCLINICITY.dimensionless_equation: Z5=|D ln(n_e) cross D ln(p)|^2/(|D ln(n_e)|^2 |D ln(p)|^2)
I5_BAROCLINICITY.interpretation: squared sine of the projected density-pressure gradient angle; scalar activation only, never an inferred in-plane direction

gradient_support.statistic: For each adaptive region and gradient, compute sqrt(mu^T Cov^+ mu) from the two posterior gradient components.
gradient_support.reason: The fixed quadratic density control has 21 coefficients; requiring 32 supported regions prevents an underdetermined or nearly saturated novelty score.

five_base_predictors: log of max(l times |D ln gas surface density|, 1e-12)
l^2 times the gas-surface-density log-Hessian trace
l^2 times the gas-surface-density log-Hessian anisotropy
density_novelty_control.standardization: center and scale each base predictor within cluster, draw, scale, radius and supported-region set
density_novelty_control.fixed_basis: intercept plus five linear terms plus five squares plus all ten pairwise interactions; exactly 21 coefficients
density_novelty_control.estimator: ordinary least squares using a Moore-Penrose inverse with rcond 1e-12
density_novelty_control.cross_validation: analytic leave-one-region-out PRESS residual e_i/(1-h_ii); fail if any 1-h_ii is at most 1e-6
density_novelty_control.I4_response: joint two-component q_plus/q_cross response; report component scores and gate on the rotation-invariant sum of component PRESS divided by the sum of component total variance

cluster_feature_summary.I4_activation_per_draw: root mean square of the supported region A4 values
cluster_feature_summary.I4_direction_per_draw: axial angle of the supported-region mean q_plus/q_cross tensor; a vanishing resultant fails
cluster_feature_summary.detection_sigma: posterior median divided by half the 16th-to-84th percentile width
cluster_feature_summary.orientation_width: 2.5th-to-97.5th percentile width after wrapping axial residuals about the doubled-angle circular mean

robustness_and_decision_gates.projection_draw_pass_definition: A draw passes when its activation changes by at most 10% across 50/100 kpc and 250/350/500 kpc, and for I4 its axial direction changes by at most 10 degrees across those same comparisons.
robustness_and_decision_gates.leave_one_region_out_definition: On posterior-median region features, an omission passes when activation changes by at most 10% and, for I4, axial direction changes by at most 10 degrees.
robustness_and_decision_gates.action_derivation_authorization: Authorize an action derivation only if I4 passes as a direction in both clusters and at least one of I4 amplitude or I5 scalar activation passes every gate in both clusters. The same I4 tensor may satisfy both roles.
robustness_and_decision_gates.failed_source_action: If neither eligible feature passes, do not open lensing and do not invent an action. Obtain a direct gas-velocity measurement or preregister a new independent merger sample.

future_outputs.per_branch_region_summary: hash-bound NPZ containing posterior region features, support masks, control predictors and PRESS scores

claim_boundary: V19BL freezes a source-only scoring calculation; its present preflight is not an observed source result.
A future I4 or I5 pass identifies a robust projected baryonic state not reducible to the registered density controls; it does not show that gravity or lensing follows that state.
I5 has no measured in-plane orientation, and I4 supplies only a projected 2D tensor rather than a complete 3D stress.
The two development clusters can reject candidates but cannot establish population universality.
No field content, action placement, propagation wavelength, coupling, gravity constant, lensing multiplier or object-specific parameter is selected.
